verdict.rationale: Performance at scale and item caps are a fair question for a work-management product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents task limits, per-project or per-workspace caps, or performance with tens of thousands of tasks. The only related material is old, anecdotal community complaints about general web-app slowness, which is not documented capability.

support.subject: As an engineer, I know how the product performs and whether item caps apply in workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks
